search.note: Same built-in bot, 24 games per variant, 2/3/4 players and eight fixed seeds. Bot has no human utility model; purchases and alternatives do not prove human preference or seat fairness.

duplicates.note: Isolates removal of support/stress before search price change; same 56 rotated 3/4-player matchups. Final-board ownership is not a count of all earlier escape boards.

summary.note: Diagnostic timing test: subtract the full earlier refund from cash at a later same-week purchase/placement. Fungible cash and prior spends mean this is not a counterfactual game outcome.
